title: Coffee bag lifestyle
prompt_en: 16:9 medium shot. A kraft paper coffee bag sits on a sunlit kitchen counter next to a steaming mug; morning light streams through blinds, casting striped shadows that slowly move. Calm, warm, natural.
prompt_zh: 16:9 中景。牛皮纸咖啡袋放在洒满阳光的厨房台面上，旁边是一杯冒热气的咖啡；晨光穿过百叶窗投下条纹阴影并缓慢移动。安静、温暖、自然。
why_it_works: Lifestyle context with moving shadows adds life while the product itself stays still and undistorted.
